einzeiler: A dramatic tale of two clerks gambling away their employer's money in 1860s Japan.
kurzfassung: Two clerks in 1860s Yokohama embezzle thousands from their employer to cover gambling debts and attempt to flee to America by sea. When cornered by a police boat during a sudden storm, their escape ends in tragedy and mystery. The story concludes with the runaway yacht vanishing into the Pacific Ocean with its dead crew.
stichpunkte: Life in treaty-port Yokohama during the volatile political conflicts of the mid-1860s
Head clerk Henry Jelland drags fellow clerk Willie McAvoy into heavy gambling losses
The pair embezzle over five thousand pounds of their employer's funds from the office safe
Prompted by an impending Monday morning audit, they buy a small yawl named Y'all Matilda
They set sail for America under the cover of darkness with the stolen money
Employer Randolph Moore discovers the empty safe and spots the becalmed vessel offshore
As a police boat approaches, Jelland shoots McAvoy and himself before a sudden storm hits
The runaway yawl jams its helm and vanishes into the Pacific Ocean forever

clips.hook: Life feels most beautiful when death casts its shadow.
clips.text: The narrator explains how living amidst constant danger makes people appreciate every single minute of their existence and prevents them from wasting time.

clips.hook: Over five thousand pounds of stolen employer money gone.
clips.text: The two clerks realize after another night at the gaming table that they have burned through a massive amount of funds belonging to their boss.

clips.hook: Buying a tiny vessel to smuggle stolen gold to California.
clips.text: The desperate clerks plan to purchase a small available boat equipped with supplies, load it with five thousand sovereigns from the safe after dark, and sail across the ocean.

clips.hook: Spotting the runaway yacht through a spyglass.
clips.text: The furious merchant rushes down to the shore, scans the water with his glasses, and triumphantly spots the fugitive vessel out on the horizon.

clips.hook: A small yacht drifting across the Pacific with a dead crew.
clips.text: The narrator reflects on the bizarre fate of the runaway vessel carrying a massive cargo of bullion and two lifeless men into the open ocean.

beschreibung:
Tonight, I’ll be reading “Jelland’s Voyage” by Arthur Conan Doyle.... a lesser-known tale from the legendary creator of Sherlock Holmes.
Settle in for a journey shaped by the sea, adventure, and Doyle’s unmistakable gift for transporting us into another time and place.
Turn down the lights, get comfortable, and let tonight’s story carry you away as you slowly drift off to sleep.
